messages:
Marta (CS): Heads-up — AcmePay is getting repeated function-call failures in prod after the prompt-template tweak earlier. Error from their email sending service: "400 schema validation failed: 'recipient' expected string but got object". Logs + sample request below.

Alex (Support): Can you paste the raw API request, function schema, and the model's function_call output? Also environment (hosted/dedicated/private) and timestamps.

Marta (CS): Prod is Dedicated (us-west-2). Sample request (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that helps send transactional emails."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Send welcome email to John"}
  ],
  "functions": [
    {
      "name":"email_tool",
      "description":"Send email",
      "parameters": {
        "type":"object",
        "properties": {
          "recipient": {"type":"string", "description":"email address"},
          "subject": {"type":"string"},
          "body": {"type":"string"}
        },
        "required":["recipient","subject","body"]
      }
    }
  ],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```
Model returned:
```
{"name":"email_tool","arguments":"{\n  \"recipient\": {\"name\": \"John Doe\", \"email\": \"john@acmepay.com\"},\n  \"subject\": \"Welcome\",\n  \"body\": \"Hi John...\"\n}"}
```
API error: "schema validation failed: recipient must be string". The model is serializing arguments as a JSON string where recipient is an object.

Jamie (ML Eng): Thanks — this matches a prompt-template change I reviewed ~2h ago. The examples in the system prompt include a few-shot where recipient is shown as an object: `{name, email}`, which nudges the model to output an object even though the function schema expects a primitive. This is classic schema drift from examples -> function args.

Chris (Product): Customer wants a hotfix now. Options: rollback prompt change, update function schema to accept object, or add transformation layer to coerce `recipient` -> string (prefer `recipient.email`). Rolling forward could have downstream impacts.

Alex (Support): Marta, can you share one failing request_id and the tenant id and I'll open a ticket and ask SRE to pull full logs. Also need sample model response with headers (content-type etc.)

Marta (CS): Request id: req_202503021215_9ab3. Tenant: acmepay-prod-42. Full model output attached in the ticket. Customer says this started after owners updated onboarding template.

sre-bot: Deploy log — prompt-template v1.14 deployed by infra@ops at 1751236800

Jamie (ML Eng): Quick mitigation plan I can push:
- Revert the few-shot examples that show recipient as object (hot rollback).
- Add a system-level instruction: "When calling functions, only emit primitive values for parameters typed as string/number/boolean in the function schema." (short-term patch)
- Longer term: add a pre-call validator on our side that will coerce common object shapes into primitives (e.g., pick `.email` or `.id`) and return a clear validation warning to the user.
I'll start with the revert + system instruction. Should reduce failures immediately.

Alex (Support): I've created ticket CS-4571 and assigned to @Jamie. ETA to customer: 2 hours for rollback + validation patch, will follow up in 30 min with interim update. :thumbsup:

Chris (Product): If we push a middleware coercion it needs opt-in per tenant. Marta, please ask AcmePay if they'd accept a temporary coercion fix while we clean templates.

Marta (CS): Will confirm with customer now and paste their ok/no in CS-4571. Thanks team.
